description:
ASTRAVION – TEAM DESCRIPTION

ASTRAVION is a team of passionate, creative, and innovative individuals driven by curiosity and a shared interest in science, technology, and space exploration. We believe that every great discovery begins with an idea, and every meaningful innovation starts with the courage to explore new possibilities.
summary:
"The Forgotten Moon Landing — Abandoned but Not Forgotten" follows two hijab-wearing NASA astronauts, Shafirah and Delvia, on a special mission to the Moon.   
The Mission (Panels 1–4): Inspired by NASA's space exploration legacy since the 1960s, Shafirah and Delvia launch into space aboard a rocket and successfully land on the lunar surface.   
Discovery & Crisis (Panels 5–6): While exploring the Moon, they discover an abandoned lunar rover and equipment left behind from the Apollo era. Suddenly, their communication system fails because their antenna is damaged and nearby hills block the signal.   
Solution & Success (Panels 7–8): Using the old Apollo equipment, they locate a higher ridge with a clear line of sight to a communication satellite. Working together with their robot companion, they repair the antenna, move to the ridge, and successfully restore the signal to transmit their findings back to Earth.
